next_question.rationale: item_count is the only remaining rate-bearing dimension not yet tried (listed in rate_bearing_not_yet_tried). The top gap is large (created→confirmed lost: 417,569) and recorded reasons (user_total: 199,417; artifact_total: 42,107) leave ~176k unexplained. Recent drills show two plausible partitions: consultation_required with rx_gated rate 0.3002 vs non_rx 0.3904 (rx_gated entered: 255,293 converted: 76,641) and stock problems with has_unfulfilled_item rate 0.0928 (entered: 19,728 converted: 1,831) and has_partially_fulfilled_item rate 0.0073 (entered: 2,191 converted: 16). A cut by item_count can test whether order size correlates with these low-confirmation segments (e.g., large orders are more likely to be partially/unfulfilled or require consultation) and help allocate remaining budget toward inventory fixes, consultation flows, or UX changes.
